page: Microsoft Azure EC48ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECadsv6 family, powered by AMD processors and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This virtual machine features 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The hardware configuration includes 1843 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage options.

With its high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU, the instance is structured for memory-intensive workloads. The inclusion of a large local SSD provides fast temporary storage, while the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. This resource density makes the server qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large memory footprints combined with local scratch space, such as relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and enterprise resource planning systems.
description: Microsoft Azure EC48ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance from the ECadsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD processors and 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high-density memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance is equipped with 1843 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage configurations. Designed without integrated GPUs, this server is optimized for memory-heavy operations and data-intensive tasks. The combination of dedicated compute resources, substantial RAM, and fast local SSD storage makes the EC48ads_v6 highly suitable for enterprise databases, in-memory analytics, and large-scale transactional workloads where memory capacity and storage performance are critical.
